desc:
⚔️PvP with the newest combat: maces, end crystals, spears and TNT minecarts! Choose from 5 maxed-out kits and fight in an arena you can blow apart.

💎 Crystal: end crystals and respawn anchors
🛤️ Cart: lay rails and set off TNT minecarts
🔨 Mace: glide in with rockets and wind charges, then smash
💣 TNT: knock lit TNT at players with a spear
🗡️ Sword: netherite sword, axe and shield

⛏️ Break, build and blow up the map
🔁 Every kill restocks your crystals, TNT, rockets and more
🎒 Save your own hotbar layout for each kit
🤖 Practice against a bot on your own private map

📱 Play on PC, phone and tablet
👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like!
